text: Completed #19 font consistency. Evidence: browser consumer probe passed 42 checks; native JavaFX suite passed 122 tests. Canvas renderer and metrics use one CSS-family serializer: six generic CSS families remain unquoted; named faces are escaped and quoted. JavaFX uses the resolved-face diagnostic alternative (public resolvedFontName/resolvedFontStyle) rather than forcing Regular, so platform substitution such as macOS Helvetica Light is observable while draw and measure share resolution.
